notes:
Original and replication acquisition assessed independently. Neither full paper was available through checked open-access routes. The supplied replication cache is a matching-title publisher abstract/access page, not full text; no statistics or target-specific narrative verdict inferred from it. No sample sizes, test statistics, effect sizes or p values inferred or converted.
Source follow-up: Rendered primary p. 125 inspected. Description does not distinguish pre-exposure AIME, General AIME, and post-exposure AIME: Table 1 reports different t tests for all three. Preconceptions have n=64 for each medium (same children); post-tests have n=32 in each independent group. Thus neither a unique requested test nor its analytic sample design can be selected from this locator. The scan confirms General AIME t=-3.11**, Pre-exposure AIME t=-2.87**, and Post-exposure AIME t=-2.21*; these are alternative candidate tests, not an extracted target. Canonical TXT contains OCR inconsistencies (e.g., Pre-exposure AIME significance glyphs).
